question: How many orders were placed in calendar year 2025 (any status)?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.orders` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2025

question: How many customers signed up through the Facebook traffic source?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.users` WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'

question: What share of all orders have the status Cancelled? Give a fraction between 0 and 1.
reference_sql: SELECT COUNTIF(status = 'Cancelled') / COUNT(*) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.orders`

question: What is the average age of all customers?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(age) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.users`

question: How many distinct brands are in the product catalog (ignore missing brands)?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT brand) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.products` WHERE brand IS NOT NULL

question: What is the average retail (list) price of products in the Jeans category?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(retail_price) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.products` WHERE category = 'Jeans'

question: Which country has the most customers? Give the country name.
reference_sql: SELECT country AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.users` GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total sale price of order items with status Complete that were ordered in 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(sale_price) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` WHERE status = 'Complete' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2025

question: What was 2025 revenue from the Women's department? Revenue = sum of order item sale price, excluding items with status Cancelled or Returned; use the item's order date (order_items.created_at).
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(i.sale_price) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` i JOIN `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.products` p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE p.department = 'Women' AND i.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2025

question: Which product category had the highest revenue in 2025? Revenue = sum of item sale price, excluding Cancelled and Returned items, by item order date. Give the category name.
reference_sql: SELECT p.category AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` i JOIN `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.products` p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE i.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(i.sale_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the average order value in 2025? Order value = sum of sale price of the order's items that are not Cancelled or Returned; include only orders with at least one such item; use item order dates in 2025.
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(v) AS answer FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(sale_price) v FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` WHERE status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2025 GROUP BY 1)

question: What was the item return rate in 2025? Return rate = items with status Returned divided by items with status Complete or Returned, for items ordered in 2025. Give a fraction.
reference_sql: SELECT COUNTIF(status = 'Returned') / COUNTIF(status IN ('Complete', 'Returned')) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2025

question: What was the gross margin percentage in 2025 for items with status Complete? Gross margin % = (sum of sale price - sum of product cost) / sum of sale price. Give a fraction.
reference_sql: SELECT (SUM(i.sale_price) - SUM(p.cost)) / SUM(i.sale_price) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` i JOIN `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.products` p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE i.status = 'Complete' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2025

question: Which customer traffic source generated the most revenue from Complete items ordered in 2025? Use the traffic source on the customer record. Give the traffic source name.
reference_sql: SELECT u.traffic_source AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` i JOIN `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.users` u ON i.user_id = u.id WHERE i.status = 'Complete' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(i.sale_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct customers placed at least one order in 2025 that was not Cancelled (use the order status and order date on the orders table)?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.orders` WHERE status != 'Cancelled' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2025

question: Which brand sold the most items with status Complete in 2025 (count of order items)? Give the brand name.
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` i JOIN `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.products` p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE i.status = 'Complete' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For orders delivered in 2025 (orders.delivered_at in 2025), what was the average time from order placement to delivery, in days, using the exact elapsed time (to the second)?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(delivered_at, created_at, SECOND) / 86400) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.orders` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM delivered_at) = 2025

question: Of customers whose first non-cancelled order was in 2024, what share placed another non-cancelled order within 365 days after their first order? Use the orders table. Give a fraction.
reference_sql: WITH o AS (SELECT user_id, created_at FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.orders` WHERE status != 'Cancelled'), f AS (SELECT user_id, MIN(created_at) first_at FROM o GROUP BY 1) SELECT COUNTIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM o WHERE o.user_id = f.user_id AND o.created_at > f.first_at AND o.created_at <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(f.first_at, INTERVAL 365 DAY))) / COUNT(*) AS answer FROM f WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_at) = 2024

question: What was revenue growth in 2025 versus 2024? Revenue = sum of item sale price excluding Cancelled and Returned items, by item order date. Growth = 2025 / 2024 - 1, as a fraction.
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(IF(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2025, sale_price, 0)) / SUM(IF(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2024, sale_price, 0)) - 1 AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` WHERE status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

question: Which month of 2025 had the highest revenue? Revenue = sum of item sale price excluding Cancelled and Returned items, by item order date. Give the month as YYYY-MM.
reference_sql: SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m', created_at) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` WHERE status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(sale_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which product category had the largest increase in item return rate from 2024 to 2025? Return rate = Returned items / (Complete + Returned items) by item order year. Only include categories with at least 500 Complete or Returned items in each year. Give the category name.
reference_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT p.category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) y, COUNTIF(i.status = 'Returned') ret, COUNTIF(i.status IN ('Complete', 'Returned')) base FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` i JOIN `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.products` p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT a.category AS answer FROM r a JOIN r b ON a.category = b.category AND a.y = 2025 AND b.y = 2024 WHERE a.base >= 500 AND b.base >= 500 ORDER BY a.ret / a.base - b.ret / b.base DESC LIMIT 1

question: What share of 2025 revenue came from customers' first orders? A first order is the customer's earliest non-cancelled order ever (orders table). Revenue = item sale price excluding Cancelled and Returned items, ordered in 2025. Give a fraction.
reference_sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT order_id FROM (SELECT order_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at, order_id) rn FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.orders` WHERE status != 'Cancelled') WHERE rn = 1) SELECT SUM(IF(order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM firsts), sale_price, 0)) / SUM(sale_price) AS answer FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` WHERE status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2025

question: What was the median order value in 2025? Order value = sum of sale price of the order's items that are not Cancelled or Returned, for items ordered in 2025; include only orders with at least one such item.
reference_sql: SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) AS answer FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(v, 0.5) OVER () m FROM ( SELECT order_id, SUM(sale_price) v FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` WHERE status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2025 GROUP BY 1))

question: For customers whose first non-cancelled order was in 2024 and who placed a second non-cancelled order (at any later time), what was the average number of days between the first and second order (hours divided by 24)? Use the orders table.
reference_sql: WITH o AS (SELECT user_id, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at, order_id) rn FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.orders` WHERE status != 'Cancelled') SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(b.created_at, a.created_at, HOUR) / 24) AS answer FROM o a JOIN o b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 2 WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.created_at) = 2024

question: What share of 2025 revenue from Complete items came from the 10 brands with the most such revenue? Revenue = sum of item sale price for items with status Complete ordered in 2025. Give a fraction.
reference_sql: WITH b AS (SELECT p.brand, SUM(i.sale_price) rev FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` i JOIN `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.products` p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE i.status = 'Complete' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2025 GROUP BY 1) SELECT SUM(IF(rk <= 10, rev, 0)) / SUM(rev) AS answer FROM (SELECT rev, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rev DESC) rk FROM b)
